chapters.title: Measure theory
chapters.description: Radon representation, weak compactness, continuity sets, tightness, smooth and atomic approximation, covering lemmas, maximal estimates, and Lebesgue differentiation. Differentiation for arbitrary Radon measures from Besicovitch selection.

chapters.title: Rectifiability and integration
chapters.description: Rectifiable sets, area and coarea, Lipschitz differentiation, C1 decomposition, full tangent characterization, positive weights and intrinsic chart differentials.

chapters.title: Sets of finite perimeter
chapters.description: Distributional perimeter, reduced boundary, BV approximation, compactness, coarea, level sets, variational existence, subcalibrations, and minimizing Simons cones. Vector-measure representation, interval traces and finite-perimeter structure, and exact nonlinear jump calculus. Reduced-boundary blow-ups, polar alignment, quantitative phase persistence, graph covering and measure identification.

chapters.title: Currents and flat chains
chapters.description: Mass, compactness, flat chains, pushforwards, homotopies, slicing, Plateau existence, calibrated currents, and singular complex-curve minimizers. Scalar-to-vector Riesz representation, comass duality, and a direct sequential compactness proof. Tangential Lipschitz calculus, geometric and normal slicing, flat continuity and exceptional levels.

chapters.title: Varifolds
chapters.description: First variation, monotonicity, bounded curvature, constancy, integral compactness, tangent cones, spine splitting, support convergence, qualitative stratification, junction models, and Allard regularity. Dual first-variation energy, lower semicontinuity and conditional integral compactness. Almost-everywhere planar blow-ups with explicit multiplicity and plane-coordinate control.

chapters.title: Minimal surfaces
chapters.description: Variations, graphs, elliptic estimates, truncated power tests and Moser iteration, Jacobi fields, separated sheets, removable stability, index localization and weak convergence, compactness, geometric inequalities, scalar curvature, Bernstein arguments, and stable cones. Free-boundary stationarity, Steklov coordinates, and instability in the unit ball. Sobolev compactness and the positive Poincare constant on a connected closed manifold. Harmonic polynomials, Sobolev spectral expansions and sharp higher round-sphere gaps.

chapters.title: Min-max theory
chapters.description: Pitts, cycle topologies, discrete fineness, almost minimizing limits, existence, concentration control, cohomological detection, compact critical sets, continuous pull-tight deformations, and stationary critical limits.

chapters.title: Volume spectrum and Morse index
chapters.description: Cohomological sweepouts, metric comparison, uniform Weyl asymptotics, multiplicity one, index, and abundance.

chapters.title: Geometric applications of min-max theory
chapters.description: Willmore energy, neck constructions, and low-width model results. Conformal Willmore calculus, multiplicity and inversion, local energy estimates, and explicit logarithmic neck costs.

chapters.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces
chapters.description: Area minus volume, CMC min-max, curvature networks, exact volume constraints, strong versus constrained stability, Minkowski identities, constrained Jacobi fields, and sphere rigidity. Harmonic Gauss maps, Hopf differentials, and CMC spheres. CMC reconstruction with period and immersion conditions. Rotational equations, Delaunay flux, period variation, and bounded and square-integrable Jacobi kernels.

chapters.title: Allen-Cahn and phase transitions
chapters.description: Transition profiles, BV compactness and perimeter limits, recovery layers, Modica bounds, stress-energy monotonicity, stability and level geometry, sliding minimization, and planar and three-dimensional rigidity. Sharp normal coercivity, bounded flat kernels, curved-interface Jacobi obstructions and fixed-parameter compactness.

chapters.title: Obstacle problems
chapters.description: Variational existence and comparison, reaction measures, optimal interior regularity, quadratic blow-ups, Weiss and Monneau monotonicity, and classical singular strata.

chapters.title: Mean curvature flows
chapters.description: Smooth and weak flows, Gaussian monotonicity, weighted shrinker variations and stability, Gaussian tails and convergence, entropy maximizers, product splitting, and entropy-lowering compact perturbations. Translators: weighted variations, ground states, conformal metric, graphical calibration, curvature ratios, and complete rigidity under explicit global hypotheses. Self-shrinker curvature gaps with explicit complete-image proofs and Gaussian integrability assumptions. Graphical angle and curvature estimates, periodic long-time convergence, controlled entire-flow maximum principles, and entire graphical self-shrinker rigidity. Local graphical cutoffs, rough-data comparison, height-gradient estimates and arbitrary-growth existence.

chapters.title: History
chapters.description: Sourced historical notes on the origins of GMT and the development of min-max theory. Conformal volume, Willmore minimizers and the distinction between existence and a sharp min-max bound.

chapters.title: Examples
chapters.description: Worked examples of measures, fractal dimension, classical minimal surfaces, stability, and mean curvature flow solitons, with explicit calculations and proofs. The equatorial disk and critical catenoid include boundary spectra and second variations. Harmonic-map constructions, singularities, and concentrating energy measures. Unduloid limits and cylinder stability, positive-length Cantor sets and nonnormal currents, and four-corner pure unrectifiability. Exact weighted Jacobi calculations on grim reapers and planes, and diffuse normal currents as flat limits of real rectifiable currents. Higher-codimension shrinkers, BV representatives and jumps, and an explicit obstacle contact transition. Willmore tori and round surfaces, an inverted catenoid, and curvature concentration, boundary and multiplicity examples. Periodic phase profiles, exact instability modes, circle interfaces and geometric layer energies. Periodic graphical mean conservation and drift, and nonlinear Fourier residuals. Sharp graphical scales and expanders from radial, convex and nonconvex homogeneous cones. Explicit slicing jumps, cancellation and diffuse slices. Phase densities, sectors, crossing quadrants, collapsing slabs, cusps and null modifications. Tangent limits, positive weights, dense supports and exceptional representatives.

chapters.title: Harmonic maps and variational systems
chapters.description: Domain stationarity, stress-energy conservation, radial monotonicity, homogeneity, and finite-energy rigidity, linked to CMC Gauss maps and explicit concentration examples.
